scenarios.expected: Our Entity and external Counterparty retain their distinct roles and labels. A Contributor cannot use the Member+ Entity destination; duplicate/invalid input has a clear outcome.
scenarios.actual: Entities opened on Calendar with the Calendar link marked current; List reached the registry table with its Legal name column; Type=Branch narrowed the registry from 50 to 1 rows; Clear all restored 50 rows; Status defaulted to Active; Register saved "Rev C31 legal_team_member RVVZOT" and its jurisdiction, registration no., tax ID, agent and address, and the registry link opened the new record; Register with a blank Legal name kept the dialog open and showed "Name the entity — its registered legal name."; no Entity was created.

scenarios.expected: The guide is found from the Entity destination's Help and by its exact title, its outline and skip link work by keyboard, and it holds in Light, Dark and Warm at 320, 720 and 1440 CSS pixels and at 200 percent zoom.
scenarios.actual: The Entities destination offered a Help link, and the Help index headed "Guides for Legal Team Member" listed all four Entity guides by their exact titles; Each exact title was found by the Help search and resolved to its own article (Maintain Entities and Counterparties -> /help/entities-and-counterparties; Manage Holdings, Officers, and Registrations -> /help/entity-records; Track and file Entity obligations -> /help/entity-obligations; Manage Entity structure and access -> /help/entity-structure-and-access); Selecting "Read the calendar and Home" moved to #read-the-calendar-and-home; the focused element was H2#read-the-calendar-and-home and the section heading was in view; "Read this article in the full documentation" opened /documentation/entity-structure-and-access and showed the same guide, "Manage Entity structure and access", in the formal reader; The Help article kept its title and produced no horizontal overflow in every theme and width combination (light@320px:0px, light@720px:0px, light@1440px:0px, dark@320px:0px, dark@720px:0px, dark@1440px:0px, warm@320px:0px, warm@720px:0px, warm@1440px:0px); At an emulated 200 percent zoom (a 1440px layout halved to a 720x450 CSS viewport) the article kept its title with no horizontal overflow; Arriving at the article put focus on its H1 "track-and-file-entity-obligations"; Shift+Tab reached the outline link for the filing section with a visible focus indicator (outline: solid) and Enter followed it to #mark-a-filing-and-check-the-next-cycle; the shell's "Skip to content" link was present and targets #main.
